question: At the exact preserved aware one-sample audit policy, do direct Preparation/Surge draw and native Phantom hand-size payoff have adaptive whole-run complementary value beyond their retained background effects?
why_not_a_repeat: The closed Hand bulk/sampler studies counted necessary play patterns. The completed fixed-command source-utility and clone gates qualified an operator but did not estimate adaptive whole-run Hand value. The closed Bloodfire experiment intervened on another mediator. No old outcome is reused as a fresh observation.

operator.A: Retain/suppress BOTH direct draw effects of Preparation and Surge via the already-qualified all-instance effect view. These are alternative producers in ONE Hand family, not two strategy slots.
operator.B: Retain/suppress the native Phantom special coefficient via the qualified hand_phantom_enabled view. Suppression sets only its coefficient to zero; generic Strength or attack hooks are not deleted.
operator.retained: Source cards, Energy, HP, payments, Exhaust, Ember, relic/ordinary draw, RNG, cards/instance/target identities, background Bloodfire, native death/Block/healing envelopes and acquisition/controller bytes are unchanged.
operator.scope: Group-source necessity and interaction, not separate indispensable Preparation/Surge variants. The existing eight-mask finite source/subset gate is carried with limits; this four-world design does not claim all eight adaptive source-variant worlds.
operator.policy: The exact previous aware one-sample policy is a fixed audit instrument, not promoted by this experiment. All four worlds use identical acquisition and combat code/parameters. They act adaptively on their own public state; future commands, cards and RNG consumption are NOT forced to match treatment.
operator.access: Drawing Phantom itself is a legitimate source access pathway. Do not require source-drawn OTHER cards to identify that pathway, and do not condition the primary analysis on realised route membership.
operator.nulls: Default-on complete entry trace equality required. New constructor must apply the same masks at game construction and every factual command, and both qualified clone paths must retain them. Generic Hand grammar is not made Ash-exclusive; exact other-aspect product null is not claimed for a research Hand ablation.

seed_formula: seed_base + seed_vow_stride*vow + 4*(first//2) + j; first=0,2,...,126; j=0,1,2,3. Each of256 distinct matched seeds occurs in two predetermined configurations. Check ALL retained executable configuration metadata and protected ranges before observations; metadata collision absence is not universal randomness independence.
uncertainty: Reuse the exact pinned pure bootstrap function from causal-value-v1/read_causal.py. Resample256 complete paired-seed blocks, retaining their two assigned policies; nominal simultaneous95% Bonferroni percentile intervals. Approximate inference for the fixed policy/context design; not exact finite-sample guarantees, globally independent policies or final P9 multiplicity control.

decision.supported: Every primary lower bound strictly positive, complete matched rectangle, qualified source/clone/entry binding, zero native errors/stalls and per-world resource caps met. Only then open the already-fixed V0 rectangle. Both vows supported is still NOT a full certificate.
decision.not_established: Complete valid V5 with any primary lower bound nonpositive closes this fixed adaptive-value claim; skipV0. No additional seeds, tuning, outcome subset, alternate metric or controller. A confidence interval including zero is not proof of no benefit, equality, universal package nonviability or P9 impossibility.
decision.inconclusive: Wrong identity, failed new entry binding, incomplete data, invalid observer/clone, resource or delivery fault: preserve all assigned/available bytes; no scientific PASS. Repair only demonstrated delivery defects under unchanged estimand; no rerun of already-complete valid rows without an explicit applicable validity reason.

secondary: Retain every raw outcome and command trace, timings and CPU, configuration identities, natural offer/acquisition/deck evidence, Hand source-draw and consumer-access fields and local clone events. Original32/32/16/8 necessary-pattern support is descriptive only here. It neither rescues primary failure nor supplies a causal descriptor, universal competence or endpoint retention.

remaining_certificate_obligations.identity: Inherited one Hand family; no novelty or six-new-primitives claim. Literal historical roles and exact current dependencies retained.
remaining_certificate_obligations.causal: Prior finite source-energy/mediator/payoff/subset and clone proofs carry only their tested scope. This study supplies the missing group-adaptive value, not optimal-play or per-variant indispensability.
remaining_certificate_obligations.descriptor: The immutable factual provenance extractor is not an admitted predictor. Before admission require precommitted held-out reproducibility, intervention stability, source-access/payoff distinction and separation from peer strategies. Do not refit the old frozen validation model or substitute names/card lists for causal behavior.
remaining_certificate_obligations.policy_economy_quality: Full native reward/shop/event paths and all configurations retained. Necessary support and a positive aggregate effect are not enough: competent-policy viability, peer/exclusive functional separation, signed C2, V5 ceiling, faults/duration/global-difficulty controls remain required.
remaining_certificate_obligations.independent_confirmation: Freeze independent policies/seeds and corrected package-level error control before reading their outcomes. This adaptive-value rectangle does not consume protected5000-5199 or certify later confirmation/retention.
remaining_certificate_obligations.system_product: Three full viable/reachable/distinct strategies per aspect, seven-direction detector, corrected independent confirmation, unrestricted endpoint retention, all hard guardrails, minimal lifecycle, owner-authorized exact-head review and one exact-product/#108 receipt remain open.

preservation: Commit this contract and exact executable source hashes before any native observations. Commit derived runtime identities before invocation.
